agent_note: Clean past-tense third-person narration with heavy free indirect discourse across several point-of-view characters (Sasha, Darley, Georgiana). 19 event quotes, all past, zero present event-narration. Quotation marks survive in this book (q08252, q08253), so dialogue was identified by marks where present and by first-person present register plus direct address where absent. Two quotes (q08240, q08245) are past-tense generalizations with weak or absent story-world referents -- the contested past-gnomic class; both were kept as event/past under the present-tense-only gnomic rule and are flagged. Reclassifying both as gnomic would leave 17 past / 0 present, so neither can flip the label. q08258 is a bare fragment routed to gnomic by spec rule despite reading as truncated past narration; it likewise carries no tense either way.
